messages:
ash: Quick sec ping — PR #4821 is ready for review. Small auth change: move tenant credential fetching to a sidecar for on-prem deployments and consolidate a shared secret path. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/4821
marta: Thanks — can you paste the diff of env names? worried about global secret being accessible to all tenants.
ash: snippet:
```
ENV_SHARED_SECRET_PATH=/vault/data/redwood/shared/creds
USE_SA_PROJECTION=true
```
peter: For onprem, sidecar will mount those secrets, but we need to ensure SA scope is narrow. Add a comment in PR about which namespaces get access.
sam: @marta @peter I’ll run a quick secret-scan and check RBAC bindings. sec-bot, any automated flags?
sec-bot: Static secret-scan: no hardcoded secrets found. Note: vault path uses a shared prefix — recommend per-tenant path /vault/data/redwood/tenants/<tenant-id>/creds
marta: Also double-check KMS integration for private deployments; rotation path should be explicit, and document who has key access.
ash: Added a note about KMS in the PR and added unit test for the sidecar env var. Also updated docs/ops/onprem-secrets.md
peter: I can LGTM once sam confirms the SA role only has namespace-scoped permissions.
sam: Running smoke tests now; will post results here in ~20m. If green I'll approve.
marta: :thumbsup: thanks ash — add a short rollback runbook in the PR description just in case.
ash: done — added rollback steps + canary plan (deploy to staging namespaces first). Targeting merge by EOD if we get two approvers.
